name: CN_SRP_IMPORT_MAPPING_DTLS_ALL
description: This table contains the participant import source to target attribute mapping details

columns.name: SRP_IMPORT_MAPPING_DTL_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the mapping detail record.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: SRP_IMPORT_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the mapping record to which this detailed mapping row belongs.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: The source business object from which the source attribute will be collected from. For example, HR person, Parties, and Resource Roles.

columns.name: SOURCE_ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: The attribute to be copied and inserted into the target attribute. The attribute belongs to the source business object. For example, a source attribute of CERTIFICATION_LEVEL, is an attribute of the Parties source business object.

columns.name: SOURCE_ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: Display name of the attribute to be copied and inserted into the target attribute. The attribute belongs to the source business object. For example, a source attribute of CERTIFICATION_LEVEL, is an attribute of the Parties source business object.

columns.name: SOURCE_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE
columns.description: The data type of the source attribute, such as VARCHAR, DATE, and NUMBER

columns.name: FLEX_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Flexfield Context Segment Code, if any, of the attribute to be copied and inserted into the target attribute. The attribute belongs to the source business object.

columns.name: FLEX_CONTEXT_PROMPT
columns.description: Display Name of the Flexfield Context Segment Code, if any, of the attribute to be copied and inserted into the target attribute. The attribute belongs to the source business object.

columns.name: TARGET_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: The target business object to which the target attribute belongs. Either the participant (CN_SRP_PARTICIPANTS_ALL) or participant detail (CN_SRP_PARTICIPANT_DETAILS_ALL ) target objects

columns.name: TARGET_ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: The attribute to which the source attribute value will be inserted. For example, a target attribute for the participant detail might be ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER4

columns.name: TARGET_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE
columns.description: The data type of the target attribute, such as VARCHAR, DATE, and NUMBER

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
